method: 4096 reproducible synthetic32-byte seeds; direct procedural generator, no AI, wallet or browser
identity: Current art uses body color, a different wing color, headgear and accent derived from birth seed. Same seed yields same art/pose basis. Different seeds can share a visible image; uniqueness is not enforced.
hosting: The mint stores its seed onchain; tokenURI points to hosted JSON/SVG. Owner can change metadataBase, and a future renderer deployment can change image mapping.
